description.text: The first Battle Roads outside Japan, local tournaments in game stores: in North America from 26 May to 24 June 2007, and in other countries from 1 April to 17 June 2007. They were billed as Spring 2006-2007 because they belonged to the 2006-2007 season, which ran from one World Championships to the next, and this was that season's only circuit. The winner got the Battle Road Spring 2006-2007 Victory Medal and 8 booster packs; second place got 4 packs. Takumi Akabane's gold medal beside Pikachu is the art of the Victory Medal won at Japan's 2005 and 2006 Gym Finals.
